name: VRChat In Here
description: When you move between worlds in VRChat, posts the world name and a Join link (only for instances others can enter) to Misskey. It reads your presence from the VRChat API server-side, so unlike log-reading Windows tools it also works on Quest / Pico. Commands let you post "where I am now" or "today's visited worlds" manually. Authentication is a Secret Vault connection (Cookie header); no password or 2FA code is handled. The VRChat API is unofficial, so the plugin keeps to the suggested one request per 60 seconds and pauses 10 minutes on 429.
